overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board properly convened in executive session under Purpose 3 because the Town Manager's attorney letter threatened litigation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board's July 3, 2018 executive session under Purpose 3 was held for an improper purpose because no litigation was threatened.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Board properly met in executive session under Purpose 3 to discuss its litigation strategy with respect to this matter.
